requiredFiles.description: Written explanation of why reduce is more powerful than forEach for a specific operation

criteria: The dataset contains at least 20 items with at least 3 filterable properties, loaded from a JS object or JSON file — not hardcoded as HTML
Array methods map, filter, and reduce are each used at least once in the JavaScript code — not replaced with for loops
A real-time search input filters the displayed items as the user types, with no need to press a button
The user can filter items by at least 3 different properties (e.g., category, date, status) with visible filter controls
REFLECTION.md contains a specific, technically correct explanation of why reduce was more appropriate than forEach for at least one operation the student implemented
